latestVersion.changelog:
Editor Online 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches a cloud-based in-browser video editor, no software needed.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM uploads (up to 500MB), with 1080p MP4 exports in 30–60 seconds.
- Handles video editing requests (trimming, transitions, overlays, BGM) with AI workflows and plain prompts.
- Simple onboarding: auto-grants a 7-day, 100-free-credit token for new users.
- Includes detailed error handling and clear session/credit/export status feedback.
- Designed for content creators working with short video clips.
